license_note: The official model card releases the c4ai-command-a-03-2025 weights under CC-BY-NC-4.0 and requires compliance with the Cohere Labs Acceptable Use Policy, which Cohere's license page incorporates by reference. The noncommercial limit and the use restrictions mean the public weights are not an open-source distribution; Cohere's hosted command-a-03-2025 is offered under separate commercial terms.

access_boundary: This record represents the CohereLabs/c4ai-command-a-03-2025 weight release. Cohere's hosted command-a-03-2025 API model and its cloud-marketplace copies, downstream quantizations and fine-tunes, and later Command A releases such as command-a-reasoning-08-2025 remain separate model or service boundaries.
strengths: Cohere publishes Safetensors shards with an index, tokenizer files, and a signature file with verification instructions
The official model card documents Transformers, vLLM, SGLang, and Docker Model Runner paths, and Cohere documents a first-party API plus Azure AI Foundry and Oracle OCI hosting
tradeoffs: Artifact access is gated and the noncommercial license prevents production reuse of the weights without separate permission
The model card sets a 128K default context in its configuration and hosted availability varies by platform
